name: io.github.mihai-dinculescu/tapo-mcp
title: Tapo MCP
description: MCP server for discovering and controlling TP-Link Tapo smart home devices via AI Agents

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer token for API authentication

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL clients reach the server at; enables short-lived snapshot links

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Device discovery timeout in seconds; must be between 1 and 60

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between background device discoveries that refresh the device list; must be at least TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT and at most 86400 (one day)

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenTelemetry collector endpoint for tracing
